stock-inventory-tracker.quickAnswer: Stock Inventory Tracker keeps a simple, honest record of your shop's stock. Add each item with its quantity, unit cost, selling price, and a reorder warning level, and the tool instantly shows total stock value, potential revenue, potential profit, and a low-stock alerts list. Everything is saved automatically in your browser, a CSV export opens in Excel, and no signup is ever needed.

stock-inventory-tracker.workedExample: A kirana shop owner adds two items. 'Rice 5kg': quantity 40, unit cost 200, unit price 260, reorder level 10. 'Sugar 1kg': quantity 100, unit cost 45, unit price 55, reorder level 20. Stock value = (40 x 200) + (100 x 45) = 8000 + 4500 = 12,500. Potential revenue = (40 x 260) + (100 x 55) = 10,400 + 5,500 = 15,900. Potential profit = 15,900 - 12,500 = 3,400. Neither item is at its reorder level yet, so the low-stock list stays empty — until rice drops to 10 bags, when the alert appears.
